title: How is Marilyn Monroe connected to Putin?
description:
Five real photos connect Marilyn Monroe to Vladimir Putin, by way of the space race.

Marilyn Monroe → John F. Kennedy → Nikita Khrushchev → Valentina Tereshkova → Dmitry Medvedev → Vladimir Putin

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
